Definition
[Quasi-Fuchsian group] 1. Definition 8.7.1\group quasi-Fuchsian groupsSource: thurston:page-0206, thurston:page-0207 A Kleinian group is quasi-Fuchsian if its limit set is a Jordan curve in $S^2_\infty $ (equivalently, its domain of discontinuity has two invariant components).
